observations: Two PlayStation 4 DualShock 4 controllers are shown stacked on a black retail box.
The top controller is light blue with red accents on the analog sticks and buttons.
The bottom controller is dark blue with black accents on the analog sticks and buttons.
The box appears to be a standard retail packaging for a PlayStation 4 console.
A watermark for 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' is visible across the center of the image.
The image is taken from a high angle, showing the top surface of the box and the controllers.
No console, cables, or other accessories are visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: The controllers are clearly identifiable as DualShock 4 models.
The authenticity of the software cannot be confirmed from a photo.
The version number is not visible in the photo.
The number of games included is not shown.

risks.proof: A video showing the controllers being paired with a PS4 console and successfully navigating menus.

risks.risk: The console may be banned from the PlayStation Network (PSN) or have a hardware failure.
risks.proof: A video of the console booting to the home screen and connecting to the internet.

risks.risk: The box may be empty or contain a different item than what is pictured.
risks.proof: A photo of the actual console and all included accessories.

proof_requests: Photo of the actual PlayStation 4 console and all its accessories.
Video of the console powering on and connecting to the internet.
Photo of the console's home screen showing the system software version.
Photo of the back of the console showing the model number and serial number.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
